name: ZCA_AG_ORCHESTRATION
description: This contains the metadata for all access group related ESS jobs.

columns.name: ORCHESTRATION_ID
columns.description: Orchestration Id. System Generated Identifier and Primary Key.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: The object for which the perform object sharing rule assignment process is scheduled or run.

columns.name: ORCHESTRATION_JOB_ID
columns.description: The RequestId of the Orchestration Job which submitted the last run of the perform object sharing rule assignment process for the object.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_JOB_ID
columns.description: The RequestId of the last run of the perform object sharing rule assignment process for the object.

columns.name: LAST_ASSIGNMENT_START_TIME
columns.description: The start time of the last run of the perform object sharing rule assignment process for the object.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_JOB_FREQUENCY
columns.description: The frequency of the perform object sharing rule assignment process for the object.

columns.name: LAST_PUBLISH_TIME
columns.description: This field will be populated by the publish job. This is required for maintaining the data in the rules denorm table.

columns.name: LAST_SYNC_TIME
columns.description: This represents the last synch time for an object.

columns.name: SIGNAL_JOB_ID
columns.description: RequestId of the Job currently processing signals for the object.

columns.name: SIGNAL_JOB_LAST_SUBMITTED
columns.description: Timestamp when the Job was last submitted.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
